content: The models we use are single layer, unidirectional, seq2seq LSTMs BIBREF10 with bilinear attention BIBREF11 and trained with vanilla SGD. To determine the epoch to stop training at, we create a validation set of 2000 samples with the same characteristics as the training set, i.e., of length 5-10 with no repeated symbols. Training is stopped once accuracy on the validation set either decreases or remains unchanged. The size of the hidden state and embeddings were chosen such that they were as small as possible without reducing validation accuracy, giving a size of 32.
